title: Wayfare Pass Desk Tool Card — Restoring a Past-Due Membership
content:
# Restoring a past-due membership — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule

A past-due membership is restored when the member pays the declined renewal of the billing period in force with a payment method they now choose; the payment is booked as a renewal fee charge for that period and the membership becomes active again with the same period dates.

The amount the member pays is the restoration payment. The restoration is made by the member at their own request.

| Before the restoration | After the restoration |
|---|---|
| Status past due after the renewal fee of the billing period in force was declined | Status active, period dates unchanged |
| No membership fee collected for the period in force | A renewal fee charge for the period in force, in the amount of the restoration payment, on the membership ledger; the membership's net fees paid rise by that amount |

## Capability of the tool

`restore_past_due_pass_5ad4a609` lets the member pay the past-due renewal of their own Wayfare Pass membership with the payment method they now want to use, bringing the membership back from past due. One call collects one renewal payment for the billing period in force: it books a membership fee charge with reason renewal for that period, adds the amount to the membership's net fees paid, and sets the membership status to active with its period dates unchanged.

## How it is invoked

This is the member's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pass_membership_id` | The Wayfare Pass membership reference number being restored, as returned by the membership lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `amount` | The renewal payment collected now, in USD. | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; never empty. |

## Return

On success the tool returns a dictionary:

- `pass_event_id`: reference number of the new fee charge;
- `pass_membership_id`: the membership restored;
- `amount`: the payment collected, USD with 2 decimal places;
- `billing_period_start`: first day of the period paid for, written YYYY-MM-DD;
- `status`: the membership status once paid, active on success.

The member then sees an active membership and the new fee charge on the membership ledger.

## Hypothetical illustration of a return

For a hypothetical membership whose period in force began on 1 June, a successful call returns the new charge's reference number, the membership reference, the amount collected, a period start of 2026-06-01 and the status active.
